description: Scope clarification for new draft revisions only. Historical v1 case prompts and experiment results remain unchanged.

cases.original_prompt: Fix trimmed non-empty string schemas so whitespace-only values are rejected by construction, validation, encoding, and decoding, including Unicode whitespace. Valid padded strings must retain stable normalized round trips. Preserve forward-compatible array encoding behavior for invalid elements. Limit the change to contracts; do not change mobile routes.

cases.original_prompt: Fix the drainable worker lifecycle. A typed failure or defect in one item must be logged without preventing later queued items from processing. Item cancellation must not be logged as failure, enclosing scope cancellation must still stop the worker, and drain must resolve after shutdown, including enqueue attempts after closure.
